commits.summary: Freeze public PR predictions before JVM measurement (verification pending)
commits.body:
The watcher and scaffold can derive ranked public candidates from a production-only view. The producer enumerates binary declarations, inspects at most 64 candidates and seals its selected history, arguments, predicate and side scopes before any launch. Stage 3 binds old and new independently, compiles one caller on the old API, checks its actual scalar arguments and return or exception, and writes content-pinned receipts. An explicit paired predicate measures changes without inventing a parent prediction. An incomplete run publishes each completed candidate. Original upstream test witnesses can refine ordinary entry ranking.

All 55 change-selected suites passed. A fresh synthetic PR produced the exact public entry, four qualified domain rows on each side, and opposite offline verdicts with identical evidence. The independent evaluator checked both the receipt and its isolated execution. Spring callback instances are now linked to the functions actually registered, with the original JVM-specific lambda addresses retained separately. Jobs 20261127-044119-requalify-spring-stream-subscriptions-an and 20261127-044829-qualify-a-sealed-pr-prediction-independe repeat the original reactive histories and challenge the side cache across a physical replacement.
